rules.statement: The words 'or otherwise' in section 18 of the Ordinance No. 2 of 1877 (section 2 of Ordinance No. 21 of 1900) do not include general criminal offences committed by a notary outside his duties.
rules.supporting_quote: "It limits it to a prosecution in respect of these rules and regulations, and does not refer to prosecution for offences under the general law"
